name: shareout
description: Publish agent-made pages, collect feedback, and revise at the same link.

interface.longDescription: Publish HTML reports, proposals, walkthroughs, and interactive pages. Share a link, collect feedback, and publish revisions at the same address. A Shareout account is required. Publishing through hosted MCP also requires a host that can upload local files over HTTP.
defaultPrompt: Publish this HTML page and give me a link to share.
Read the review comments on my Shareout proposal.
Update this Shareout page while keeping its existing link.
